claims.claim: Fortune reported that Xbox plans three more rounds of layoffs: one in October, one in November and one in January 2027, citing people familiar with the plans, who said plans could change.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says the report from Fortune, citing people familiar with the plans, puts the rounds in this month, November and January 2027, and that plans could change.

claims.claim: Xbox cut 268 roles in September, and over 1,600 jobs in July; about 1,600 more cuts are planned across future quarters into early 2027.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says September's round eliminated 268 roles, the first wave in July saw over 1,600 job cuts, and the remaining 1,600 are planned across future quarters, culminating in early 2027.

claims.claim: The layoffs are part of Xbox's plan to cut 3,200 jobs in total.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun describes Xbox's ongoing efforts to cut 3,200 people, with two rounds of mass layoffs already this year.

claims.claim: Fortune also reported a Game Pass overhaul in which players would choose features such as console games, cloud gaming and multiplayer as add-ons.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun quotes Fortune on the planned overhaul.
claims.quote: have players choose features à la carte, including add-ons for console-only games, cloud gaming, and multiplayer, with the system operating on a tiered structure

claims.claim: Fortune reported that Microsoft plans an Xbox handheld for holiday 2027 and the Project Helix console for holiday 2028.
claims.evidence: The Verge says Microsoft is reportedly planning a next-generation handheld for the 2027 holiday season and Project Helix for the 2028 holidays, according to Fortune.

claims.claim: Fortune reported that Xbox's internal estimates put Project Helix at $1,200 to $1,800 for consumers if it is not subsidised.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says Fortune reports internal estimates of $1,200 to $1,800, as the price to consumers rather than component cost, assuming no subsidy.

claims.claim: The Xbox Series X launched at $500 and now costs $800; the Series S went from $300 to $500.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says the Series X launched at $500 and now costs $800, and the Series S rose from $300 to $500.

claims.claim: Eurogamer links rising console prices to the AI-driven memory and storage shortage.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says the global AI-driven memory and storage shortage has pushed up prices of consumer electronics and led Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo to raise current-gen console prices.

claims.claim: Fortune reported that the Xbox and Windows teams disagreed over the handheld's operating system.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says the report revealed a divide: Windows wanted a slimmed-down Windows Home, Xbox wanted specialised software; an executive reportedly threatened to end the handheld project.

claims.claim: Helen Chiang, Xbox's first chief operating officer, left Microsoft on 23 October, three months after being promoted in July; she had been at Microsoft for 21 years and previously led Minecraft.
claims.evidence: The Verge says, citing an internal memo, that Chiang is leaving Microsoft today after 21 years, having headed Minecraft before being promoted to COO in July.

claims.claim: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced the departure in a short internal memo.
claims.evidence: The Verge quotes Sharma's memo.
claims.quote: Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today. I’m grateful for her years of service and wish her well,

claims.claim: Microsoft declined to discuss the circumstances of Chiang's exit.
claims.evidence: The Verge quotes Xbox vice president of communications Kari Perez.
claims.quote: We don’t discuss individual personnel matters,

claims.claim: A source told Eurogamer that Chiang was allegedly terminated for policy violations; Eurogamer could not verify this.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says a verified source familiar with the situation alleged Chiang was terminated for policy violations, which Eurogamer has not independently verified.

claims.claim: Le Monde reported that Arkane Lyon, the Dishonored and Deathloop studio, has until 13 November to find a buyer or face closure, with 217 jobs at stake.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, citing Le Monde, says the deadline to find a buyer ends on 13 November and that 217 workers could lose their jobs if the closure goes ahead.

claims.claim: French law requires a company with more than 1,000 employees to spend three months seeking a buyer before closing an operational arm.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says, per Le Monde, French law requires a company with more than 1,000 employees to spend three months seeking a new buyer before closing an operational arm.

claims.claim: Microsoft told Le Monde it continues to explore options for Arkane.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer quotes Microsoft's statement to Le Monde.
claims.quote: We continue to explore various options for Arkane as part of the ongoing French consultation process

claims.claim: Double Fine, Undead Labs and Compulsion Games went independent, and Ninja Theory is likely to close after two acquisition deals fell through.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says Microsoft revealed Double Fine, Undead Labs and Compulsion Games would go independent, and Ninja Theory is likely to close after two acquisition deals fell through.

claims.claim: It is unclear what happens to Arkane Lyon's Marvel's Blade; The Verge previously reported it was over budget and targeting 2027.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says it is unclear what might happen to Marvel's Blade, and cites a Verge report that it was over budget and targeting 2027 after an internal delay.

claims.claim: Microsoft confirmed in July that 3,200 Xbox employees will eventually lose their jobs in the restructuring.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says the officially announced layoffs in July brought confirmation that 3,200 Xbox employees will eventually lose their jobs.

claims.claim: A Helix console at $1,200 would be a 50 percent increase on the Series X's current price.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says a Helix console at $1,200 would mean a 50 percent increase on top of Series X's current price.
